简介: Dustin Loose’s career as an actor and director began at the Theater Bonn, among other places. From 2007 to 2014, he attended the Film Academy Baden-Württemberg. His graduation film THE LAST WILL (2015) received the Student Academy Award. His debut as a director came with TATORT – DÉJÀ-VU (2018). At the 2025 Munich International Film Festival, his film DISCLOSURE received the Bernd Burgemeister TV Production Award.
